scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.archive:ios: cap sync ios && node scripts/check-ios-release.mjs --require-signing && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -archivePath ios/App/output/OutOfSight.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
scripts.export:ios: node scripts/check-ios-release.mjs --require-signing && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/App/output/OutOfSight.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ios/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath ios/App/output/AppStore -allowProvisioningUpdates
